limitations: Measured PocketIC costs are extrapolated linearly; the simulator does not claim mainnet instruction or subnet-cost equivalence.
Continuous has no protocol delay. The model evaluates completed-poll intervals [1, 2, 5, 10] seconds; all are assumptions until production observations establish an effective rate.

Traffic is deterministic. Global notifications are charged once per global subscriber for each nonempty poll; specific notifications use the configured matching-block and subscribers-per-match assumptions, capped once per subscriber per poll.
Each workload's blocks-per-poll capacity is a modelling assumption. Completing a 4,096-block PocketIC backlog does not establish a hard protocol or mainnet maximum.
Funding and pricing maintenance costs are residual estimates from integrated scheduler measurements, not independently isolated lane benchmarks.
Funding inputs are assumptions. Productive principal remains staked in Jupiter; only synthetic maturity-derived payouts are credited as liquid cycles.
The model distinguishes average sustainability from liquidity timing, but does not predict ICP price, XDR rate, maturity, conversion execution, or subnet congestion.
Input measurements lacked integrated scheduler evidence; offline maintenance cost is zero and reported as unmeasured for this dataset.
